description: This file contains tests for helper functions related to processing WhatsApp inbound messages, including extracting text, contact info, media placeholders, and location data.

methods.name: extractText
methods.description: Extracts main text content from various message types, prioritizing conversation text, captions, and contact vCards.

methods.name: extractMediaPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a placeholder string for media messages based on the message type.

methods.name: extractLocationData
methods.description: Extracts location information from location or live location messages, including coordinates, caption, and address.
